meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能把网页应用部署到Vercel。它会先本地构建检查，再用命令行上传，最后确认线上地址能正常访问后，才把链接发给你。同时还能管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布或上线网页应用，或管理Vercel的项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude会先本地构建，再部署并验证URL

say.text: 看看我在 Vercel 上有哪些项目
say.note: 会运行项目列表命令列出项目
会把域名添加到当前Vercel项目

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude deploy web apps to Vercel. It runs a local build check first, then uploads via the CLI, and confirms the live URL works before sharing it. It can also manage projects, domains, and environment variables.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude builds locally, then deploys and checks the URL.

say_en.text: Add the domain example.com to the project.
say_en.note: Adds the domain to the current Vercel project.
